content.label: Difficult to edit and update and delete
There’s no reasoning behind this. Why 24? I want to fit a lot more to track because I am very specific with my goals.
This app is actually amazing, cleanest UI I’ve ever seen, it’s super motivating checking off one task at a time! Thank you!

From start to present I’ve been a big fan of the streaks app. I got it as part of an endeavor to get on top of my habits. It’s one time pricing, offline usability and myriad of action buttons all support action over optimizing planning and analytics. 

What I would love to see is a calendar tracker that logs attempts alongside misses and successes—this would offer a more nuanced view of progress overtime. I have a 10k step goal and it’d be helpful to see whether or not my misses are short a few 100 steps or a few 1000 steps

I stopped using this app across multiple devices (just iPhone) years ago, because the sync over iCloud was complete garbage. Tried setting it up again today across devices to see if anything had improved—it’s atrocious. I purged everything from iCloud (four Streaks entries appeared there). Upon re-enabling it, I got deleted items, duplicated items, items out of sync, and it even broke the iPhone app where it now fails to even let me complete an item (rolling back the completion). It’s utterly useless. To be clear, this is not the developer’s fault—iCloud sync is deplorable on every app where it’s used, including Apple’s own apps. But the developer should consider using something else. It’s a shame, because the underlying simple idea behind this app is good. If you’re going to use it, stick to just one device.

I really enjoy using this app to develop habits! It’s almost just right for me. The app is easy to navigate, and it’s satisfying to create a new habit and click the buttons. The introduction of the Halloween theme was definitely a nice touch. Makes me feel like the app gets and respects its viewers. No one has to make a Halloween theme but you did it anyway and I feel special when changes like that occur. 

The only thing I’d suggest is that sometimes I’d like to give my habits a specific name, but the space is a bit limited—only 28 characters. This makes it a bit harder to set an intention. There’s a section where you can write notes, but it’s just not the same as seeing the text on the screen right away when you open the app. 

All in all I’m happy with the app. Definitely worth the money.

I almost never write reviews, but a couple days into using this one and I had to share in case anyone was doubting this purchase. I’ve been using another tally app for a long time now and was always annoyed that the only way to get full functionality was to do a yearly subscription. That’s ridiculous! I also really wanted to use Siri to log calories and water and so on. I downloaded some free tally apps and free trials, but they all had something I didn’t like about them. Anyways, Streaks is perfect! I have Siri Shortcuts set up for my Health app that tie into this app so I can tell my data to Siri and she updates both apps. I prefer using Streaks for checking my progress on habits just because it’s a much cleaner, visual app than health. There is also so much customization available with Streaks - I’m really happy I bought it!
Definitely helpful with forming better habits.

L’app est sympa mais fonctionne mal quand on veut sync avec tablette et montre : les données ne se mettent pas toujours à jour, surtout dans les widgets. De plus, il y a des bugs dans l’affichage… j’inscris que je veux faire 15km de course par semaine et sur le tableau de bord  c’est inscrit 40… situation similaire pour l’objectif de vélo.
Very unintuitive UI. Also keeps sending notifications for weekly tasks that have already been checked off for the week.
it is very practical

title.label: I broke my bad addictions thanks to this app

content.label: The daily reminders and visuals it offers has allowed me to become more organized. I couldn’t be more thankful for having something like this.

I paid for this because saw that it could do pomodoro timer. It works great on phone, ios and mac. 

The issue is you have to set a goal and it won’t go over once you reach the goal. I get that it’s not the foal of the app. Seems like a simple feature that would make me actually use the app. Seen a lot of requests for this.
Hard to add/edit tasks, poor help.

good app, but it will permanently write data to iCloud storage that can’t be deleted, developer and apple support can’t figure out how to remove the Streaks data.  Not the end of the world, but still quite annoying.  Poor coding?  No other app has ever done this.
Simple to use and very helpful.

Great app overall - I like the one time fee, Apple Watch integration, and ability to track a week of tasks (like minutes of exercise a week, rather than daily). However, its UI is a bit unintuitive (though learnable) and it stops counting if you exceed a task. The latter is particularly frustrating, as it’s nice to know by how much you exceed a task, to adjust future goals. It has potential, but isn’t there yet.
Tutorial doesn’t help with questions. Won’t let me add new tasks.
I love how simple this app is. If it’s not simple I don’t use it haha

Extremely helpful and motivating in building & maintaining essential habits! I am so much more likely to complete the same habits after start using Streaks. Keep up the good work! It’d be nice to have a centralized interface for viewing all the notes for each task (e.g. a page listing the daily notes with associated dates), as I record my activities for the day in the notes and this will make it easier to review.

Our daily and weekly habits, consistently applied over a long period of time, can transform our life. This app helps me to cultivate the keystone habits for the core areas of my life that I really care about.

The app is fairly priced, simple, well designed, and a joy to use. I owe the author(s) of this app a debt of gratitude. Thank you!

This app do everything you need. You can add widgets, and have it in the menu bar with a changing icon showing your progress. 
The business model is pay once and use it forever. This is wonderful. As soon as I saw that, I bought it immediately. The other apps with subscription are missing a lot of clients. I will never buy a subscription.

Does not seem to have a trial period. Does not have a way to create and view categories of habits, other than choosing an icon and a colour. This does not enable one to set goals for particular life areas. If all you want is to track disjoint habits it might work for you.
If you exceed your goal, such as reading for an hour when the target is 30 minutes, there's no way to record this extra effort.

title.label: Cloud sync across devices is effectively useless

content.label: I purchased this app on all my apple devices (MacBook 2024, Apple Watch series 10 and iPhone 15). I expected to be able to, e.g., track my water consumption throughout the day by incrementing my goal on whichever device I have on hand after drinking a glass of water. That’s fine, but the devices rarely, if at all, sync with each other. E.g., earlier today, I added on my phone 4 increments to my daily goal of 14 cups of water. I check my watch and my MacBook, and they’re not updated, despite cloud sync being enabled on all devices. It’s been nothing but frustration.

All my tasks suddenly doubled.

And they have been re-arranged.

Total mess,

Thanks a bunch.

PS: Now I see my data is also gone. Well done.

For any other victimes of this update, you can re-import your data by going to Prefs > Manage Data > Backups  and select the most recent that ran before the update.

PPS: The next day many of my tasks again appeared TWICE. ie two icons etc. Others have disappeared. Incredible.

Love the app, but with the new update the widget is no longer useful. I used to be able to click the checkmark and it would check off the task. Now I have to open the app in order to do that. Other than that I love that app.
Perfect at what it does. Made my life better. Love it.

Hi hi, this app is good for tracking weekly streaks. That’s it. It’s got good integration with Apple Health and it is super simple and fun to use every day. 

But.. after a few weeks, one wants to view the data of the results of the work put in. Alas, there’s no way to compare the various task results, collate them into a larger calendar.. really there’s just no way to view more than one task’s calendar at a time. 

Argh. I’m out and back to habit tracker or others.. I’m out $8 CAD, but it was fun trying it out.

It’s really straightforward and simple to use. They focus a lot on the streaks aspect of habits and it does trigger some sort of response in me to keep it going even when I feel tired or unmotivated. Works way better than any other habit tracking app but I wish there was an optional map display of seeing your progress with your habits (for example if I keep a 20 day streak, I’d see on the map I’m 25% of the way to reaching my ultimate goal or etc.)
iOS 17 released interactive widgets. I do not want to have to open the app every time I log something. This app is dated.

title.label: Easy to use and powerful habit tracker

content.label:
Just excellent, easy to use and powerful habit tracker. 
Don’t waste your time looking for a better habit tracking app.
I DIDNT EVEN BOUGHT THE SUBCRIPTION BUT THEY MADE ME PAY 10$!!! YALL BETTER GIVE ME A REFUND OR IM GONNA SUE YOU

Have tried 3 other habit apps and have been disappointed with complicated / busy displays, unintuitive etc. Wanted simple nice tactile UI which is easy / simple to use and flexible. 

8 days in it has already made a huge difference for me personally. I didn’t think I would possibly need more than 24 slots - but based on how well things are going I can see why others have raised this. 100pct worth the 8 dollars.

One thing worth noting from a UI perspective - short taps and long holds unlock different things. At first it was unintuitive for me to do a long hold on a button but its really smart and reduces clutter - other app devs should consider.

I thought I’d hate the simplicity of this app. I also thought I’d hate the constant reminders and notifications. But, strangely, after my first 5 day streak I started really pining for those stars and realized that this app works. You just have to be honest with yourself, streaking when you haven’t accomplished your goal only makes the streak a fake one, and quickly, you’ll see results and strive for them. Simple, but effective.
As others have said, it’s not often an app makes a positive difference in one’s life.
This app has helped me to break bad habits and create new great ones! I am eternally grateful :)

title.label: Clunky app with awful health integration

content.label:
This app is clunky, hard to navigate and doesn't look good at all. I was willing to suffer through that for functionality, but it doesn't even have that. I tried to have it count my steps and automatically tick off a step goal, but it's throwing out completely random numbers for the steps. Other apps will either add up all my steps from my Apple Watch and phone, or only count the steps from my phone. This one does neither and shows a number no other app shows so it's completely useless.

Wish I had a chance to try it for free like most other apps have but no. I had to waste $9 on a useless app.

title.label: Makes it easy creating and following habits

content.label:
I love this app. 
It really makes it easy creating and following new habits.

I recently started using this app and it’s working well for me. I enjoy lists and marking things off and I don’t enjoy having notification icons on my phone. So far both the satisfaction I get from marking a goal complete and the slight bother that the notification icon causes when I haven’t completed a daily goal are working for me! I’m doing the things I should be doing and it’s making me feel better mentally and physically already! The only reason I give 4 stars for now is that some aspects are a little confusing and the help section doesn’t help me understand some of the grey areas quite well enough. I still highly recommend this as a tool to help yourself make changes or stay on track with goals.

I bought this app in 2018 and I have loved it until recently. I have 3 pages 1 to record my physio exercises, 1 to record cardio exercises, 1 to record meditation etc. However recently my habit records have disappeared (3 times now. I would like to know is there a limit to the data that can be saved, is it an app glitch or something else.

title.label: Great app that does exactly what you need it to

content.label: Nothing more, nothing less. Streaks is a laser focused habit tracker that helps you be a better human.

I like the app it’s very simple to use. Major flaw is the 24 habit limit. It makes no sense to have the app limit the number of pages/ habits one can track. It seems the developers have purposefully not added such a simple feature. Would be 5 stars if this feature existed.

À moins d’erreur de ma part, il n’est pas possible de créer des tâches annuels. Exemple, lire 10 livres par années. Cela pour être très motivant dans divers scénario ! Sinon très complet et simple à comprendre :)

title.label: Easy to use, but could use some improvement

content.label: Great app easy to use. With there were more than four pages so you could add more items that are done less frequently as well as group more categories together for ease of use. I don’t understand limiting it to 24 items.

title.label: Streaks has helped me develop better habits

content.label: ..over the past 4yrs

It’s simple to use but not worth the money spent.

On the day of or week of you can see a brighter colored circle for streaks which is great to see progress but then all the circles become a faded color so  if you want to review the last few months all the days are a faded color including the missed days.

So you cannot see a visual progress over the months highlighting your streak. It’s annoying and useless.

title.label: Great app, with active, responsive dev team

content.label: 👍👍 worth it, and I have 4 streaks approaching 3 years at this point

You pay once and you have the greatest app of all time. 
I’ve been using doulingo for 38 days now just because I didn’t want to lose my streak , then I was thinking it would be so great to have an app that can track all the new routines, so I could keep doing it until they become habit. 
It’s super simple to use it and it pushes you to do your things. 
Loving it

The design of this app is excellent for someone who would otherwise go too far in adding too much at once.

The clean, straighfoward design doesn't ask too much or give too many options. I think this is a wise design decision. Love that it's pay once and I just discovered that it works on macOS as well.

Great value for a tightly integrated app between my phone, Mac, and watch.
